identity: Goldmead grows the grain, and Requisitioner Hobb books it as his own: grain, cloth and even a witness entered as cargo.

quests.title: A Harvest Worth Stealing
quests.text: Crumb's accounts name Requisitioner Hobb as the man he answered to. Hobb's collectors will find precious little to steal if we cannot bring the harvest in. Hunt eight Bracken Foxes by day in the {name:orchards}, which lie {zone_area:orchards}; the pickers need room to work. We will untangle Hobb's business once ours is back on its feet.
quests.lesson: Same neutral rule, new names: read the level range, not the name.

quests.title: The Granary Has Teeth
quests.text: I can account for every sack that leaves Goldmead, except the ones leaving a mouthful at a time. Kill eight Granary Rats after dark in the same {name:orchards}. Work the edges and keep your distance between fights; a squealing rat is an invitation to all its neighbours.
quests.lesson: One area, two clocks; a night hunt waits while day work goes on.

quests.title: Tusks in the Wheat
quests.text: Ridgeback Tuskers are flattening the {name:wheatfields}, {zone_area:wheatfields}, and the farmers have already lost enough this season. Bring down eight by day. Their red names mean they will charge without provocation, so give yourself room and face them one at a time.
quests.lesson: Aggressive animals in open fields: one at a time.

quests.title: Jon Has the Other Half
quests.text: You have seen what threatens our harvest; Jon Vale has been watching the people who take it. Follow the road to Goldmead Outpost and speak with him about Hobb's collectors. He counts wagons more patiently than anyone I know, though I doubt he would welcome that on his gravestone.
quests.lesson: Hub to hub inside the home zone.

quests.title: Iron Before Promises
quests.text: Hobb has sent enough paper promises to patch every roof in Goldmead; our granary doors need something sturdier. Bring me six Iron Bars and four Coal Lumps from the valley's ore. Check what pick the rock needs before digging, then smelt the iron in a furnace. The grain we still have deserves a sound door.
quests.lesson: The Bronze Pickaxe opens iron; smelting is anyone's work.

quests.title: Counted and Sealed
quests.text: The granary has its iron; now we must see the shipment safely packed. Bring me four more Iron Bars and six planks of any wood here in Goldmead Village. I will count and seal the load myself, and the next collector who calls it his wages can explain that to my face.
quests.lesson: Finite repair orders; prepare them between hunts.

quests.title: Feed the Counters
quests.text: Our grain counters have worked through dinner again, which improves neither their sums nor their company. Bring me eight cuts of Raw Meat here in Goldmead Village; whatever you saved from the road will do. They deserve a meal they cannot accidentally enter as grain.
quests.lesson: Saved loot pays off on arrival.

quests.title: Cloth Around the Truth
quests.text: The Roadside Bandits at the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} are carrying our packing cloth as though they bought it. Bring me two lengths of Linen Cloth from them; cloth you saved from an earlier fight will do. Their camp is occupied day and night, so fit the errand around your other work. I would like one shipment to reach its buyer with both its wrapping and its contents intact.
quests.lesson: Camp loot doubles as a delivery.

quests.title: Bounty: Burrow Gnawers
quests.text: I mend the sacks; the Burrow Gnawers put in fresh ventilation. Kill eight after dark in the {name:hedgerows}, which run {zone_area:hedgerows}, and come back for your bounty. This is repeatable work: I can offer it again twenty minutes after you turn it in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable bounty: optional XP and copper.

quests.title: Collectors Without a Collection
quests.text: Hobb's Roadside Bandits hold the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} day and night, demanding payment from people who have already paid. Defeat eight of them. Watch for their Bandit Lookouts and approach from the edge; a collector with a bow is much less persuasive once you are beside him.
quests.lesson: A camp with a ranged minor role.

quests.title: Teeth Along the Cart Track
quests.text: A cart that gets past Hobb's men still has to pass the Thicket Vixens in the {name:thickets} {dir_of:goldmead_outpost:thickets}. Hunt six by day. Their red names mean they attack on sight, so keep a clear way out of the brush. I want the drivers home with their boots still occupied.
quests.lesson: Aggressive forest animals; a daytime job while the camp respawns.

quests.title: A Witness, Not Cargo
quests.text: Pella Thatch is being held in the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}, where Hobb's men have entered her in their accounts as cargo. Clear your approach and speak with her about what she has seen. She knows Hobb's ledgers and remembers every stolen sack. Best not to mention the cargo entry unless you have time to hear her opinion of it.
quests.lesson: A quest giver inside a hostile camp.

quests.title: Bounty: Roadside Bandits
quests.text: Another batch of Roadside Bandits is collecting at the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}; apparently robbery offers steady employment. Defeat eight and report back for payment, by day or night. You can take this bounty again twenty minutes after turning it in.
quests.lesson: Repeatable bounty at the end of the watch line.

quests.title: Nobody Requisitions Pella
quests.text: Hobb listed me between grain and packing cloth, then had the nerve to ask whether I could write. His Bandit Lookouts guard the {name:requisition_camp} {dir_from_giver:requisition_camp} day and night; defeat eight of them. Approach from the edge and break their line of fire when you need to. I would lend a hand, but they requisitioned my good boots too.
quests.lesson: An archer camp: break line of sight, pull the edge.

quests.title: Hobb's Last Requisition
quests.text: {name:requisitioner_hobb} keeps his books in the {name:requisition_camp} {dir_from_giver:requisitioner_hobb}, and every line makes our grain his property. Defeat him, by day or night, and come back to me. I know what those books say; what I need now is someone to stop him enforcing them. Nobody requisitions Pella Thatch.
quests.lesson: Named normal leader at the camp centre.

quests.title: Highcourt Must Hear This
quests.text: Every false requisition Hobb wrote carried a capital toll mark, and I can tell you exactly whose grain he stole. Go to Highcourt and give Mariel Waybook our account. If anyone asks what you are carrying, say testimony. I have had quite enough of being counted as freight.
